title: NASA's Mercury fact sheet: mass 0.33010×10^24 kg, orbit 87.969 days
summary: The sheet lists Mercury's mass as 0.33010 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 2440.5 km, mean density 5429 kg/m^3, surface gravity 3.70 m/s^2, sidereal orbit 87.969 days, and zero natural satellites.
body: The sheet lists Mercury's mass as 0.33010 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 2440.5 km, mean density 5429 kg/m^3, surface gravity 3.70 m/s^2, sidereal orbit 87.969 days, and zero natural satellites. The sidereal rotation period is printed as 1407.6 hours. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last updated on the page: 2024-01-11.
